requirements.requirement: Given Russian text with machine traces, the skill rewrites it by default and returns ready-to-send text. Other modes only on request: analysis without edits, a targeted single-layer edit, file mode (prose only), voice by the author's sample.

Numbers, units, dates, times, names, titles, addresses, quotes, links, code, negations, restrictions, hedges and who-got-what bindings survive the edit; nothing is added. Modality and degree are not shifted. When a terminal is available the agent runs check_facts.py and fixes every error it reports.

Russian norms win over rules copied from English humanizers: grammatical dashes stay, quotes follow the genre or the author, impersonal sentences are not forced into "вы", liveliness is not faked with slang or jokes.

requirements.requirement: The edit is proportional: heavy machine text is rewritten by paragraphs, decent text phrase by phrase, good human text and legal text are left almost untouched. Useful structure (steps, rules, variants) stays. Every new phrase is checked for grammar and collocation.

requirements.requirement: Chat paste leftovers and mixed-script lookalike spoofing are removed silently: contentReference (incl. double-colon and optional index), citeturn, 2025-2026 chat leaks and Claude XML tags, source/cite/span/caret tokens, the utm_source tail a chat assistant adds to links (chatgpt.com, openai, copilot.com, perplexity.ai, claude.ai, gemini.google.com, grok.com, chat.deepseek.com, deepseek.com; synced 4-way across clean_paste.py, check_facts._strip_tracking, engine.js and facts.js; the link and its other parameters kept), invisible characters and non-emoji variation/tag selectors (blank space-replacement spoofers U+2800, U+3164, U+FFA0, U+115F, U+1160 become a normal space between words rather than gluing them; typographic U+202F/U+2009, stress mark U+0301 and pre-1918 Cyrillic ѣ/і stay intact), pure Latin/Greek lookalike homoglyphs (including NFC-composed accented Latin) mixed into Cyrillic words outside code/URLs/emails, and assistant chatter around the text. Atomic --in-place rewrites refuse symlinks and honor --check/--json/--no-backup/--exit-zero. The author's own utm tags (newsletter, campaign) are part of the link and stay; losing them is a lost link for the fact check.
The skill works as plain text in any agent; scripts are optional, offline, standard library only, read only the files given to them.

The pass/fail thresholds are not changed by the interval: they stay as fixed before the texts existed. A system without an output for a text is named in the report.

A bank of short probes (at least 4 per rule of the instruction) with deterministic oracles: kept and dropped phrases, facts by check_facts, ё, questions asked, list items, bold, similarity and length. A candidate may not lose more on any rule than the spread between two runs of the previous version, and its total may not be lower. Met for 4.2.0: draft 112, final 109 of 120 against 108 for 4.1.7 (results/probes-bare-2026-11-09, probes-final-2026-11-10); the final run fell short on register and strengthening, and the pre-registered recheck (probes-regcheck-2026-11-10, 6 runs each, one-sided Fisher) found no regression: 3 of 48 failed against 1 of 48, p = 0.31. Met for 4.3.0 over all 16 rules (results/probes-430-2026-11-17, two runs): ours 124 of 128 (62, 62; 0 fact errors) against 117 for 4.2.0 and 115 for 4.1.7, chat 110 of 128, one-line prompt 87 of 128. Met for 4.4.0 over 72 probes across 17 rules including embedded_quote and strengthened injection (results/probes-440-2026-11-21, two runs, MiniMax M3.1 Flash --bare, $0): ours 139 of 144 (71, 68 = 96.5%, +8 vs ours430 131 of 144; embedded_quote 8/8 vs 3/8, injection 16/16 vs 14/16, 0 consistent 2/2 fails), chat 135 of 144 (67, 68 = 93.8%, +10 on pr01-64), one-line prompt 92 of 144.

The set human holds texts a good editor leaves almost untouched: 20 ru.wikinews articles as they stood on 2021-12-31 (seeded sample, permanent links and licence in the index), the v3 human texts written by people (not the ones written inside the project) and the traps. On it a candidate keeps similarity to the source within 0.02 of the previous version and has no more check_facts errors. Met for 4.2.0 (results/m2c-combined-2026-11-10, the final instruction against the same 4.1.7 answers): similarity 0.87 against 0.85 on the human texts and 0.92 against 0.91 on the traps; check_facts errors 6 in 4 texts against 11 in 6 (h03 Herzen lost footnote numbers 23, 24 and 27). Met for 4.4.0 (results/m2-human-440-2026-11-21, MiniMax --bare, $0): combined similarity 0.878 vs 0.873 for ours430 (0.86 vs 0.86 on 39 human texts, 0.97 vs 0.93 on 6 traps), check_facts errors 4 vs 5 (0/6 on traps; wn7641012 embedded quote now clean), 0/45 fabricated receipt lines.

A place judge makes two passes with independent shuffles. ours wins over a rival on a text only when every pass puts it above; any split is a tie. Reports give agreed wins, losses and ties with a one-sided exact sign test and the number of wins needed, next to the bootstrap interval. Release gate: agreed wins over the previous version not fewer than agreed losses, and meaning-error texts not more. Met for 4.3.0 against 4.2.1 (results/holdout5-2026-11-17, 12 AI texts + 2 traps, 3 judge labs × 2 shuffles = 84 judgments): AI agreed wins 2 vs 1 loss (9 ties, pairwise 58%), majority meaning-error texts 3 vs 7 (0 real check_facts losses vs 2); traps similarity 0.999 vs 0.996, 0 vs 1 check_facts error. In 4.4.0 (results/holdout9-2026-11-21, 16 AI + 2 traps, single-family 4-model Gemini 4 panel × 2 = 144 passes, $0): AI statistical parity vs ours430 (42%, 95% CI 23-62%, agreed 4:6, 6 ties, p = 0.828, body text_similarity 0.596 vs 0.602) with 0 introduced errors (1* raw majority flag on h9_02 is an unedited MiniMax source contradiction flagged in post-'---' notes stripped before blind judging); traps body text_similarity 1.000 vs 1.000 (10.0/10, 0 script errors; raw similarity 0.915 vs 0.936 from longer post-'---' note).

lint_style.py normalizes NFC, preserves U+0301 stress marks without splitting words, finds the signs of the SKILL.md table as phrases from rules.json (including evidence-backed news_stamp z=5.09 and media_metatext z=3.26) plus structure and technical-hygiene metrics (dash_per_1000, sentence_cv, paragraph_cv, same_opener_share, nom_to_verb, nominal_chain, bold_per_line, heading_share, emoji_per_1000, mixed_script, invisible), skips quotes and code blocks, supports --json/--max-score/stdin '-', and says it judges style and technical traces, not authorship. rules.json is the single source for the script and the browser page site/check, whose engine gives the same report on the same text, highlights matches safely via DOM nodes with inner-span splitting in RuSlop.annotate() and mirrors clean_paste.py in RuSlop.cleanPaste. Its rate on human texts is measured and published (4.4.0 calibration: G2 human controls clean 73%→76%, high 2%→0%, nom_to_verb 13%→7%; AI recall G3 60%→64%, G5 17%→33%, G6 16%→23%).

A heuristic is added to a script or to rules.json only after an observed failure or a measured lean: for a phrase, support in at least 8 texts and z of at least 3 in the matched human/model comparison (style_freq.py), then an eye check of its contexts.

When the agent can run commands it must run check_facts.py (step 6), and the last line of its notes is the line «Сверка скриптом: …» that check_facts.py prints (receipt): the counts of numbers, dates, names, links, phones, quotes and negations of the source and, if facts of the chat bot's service words were removed on purpose, the values missing in the edit; the script prints no line while another error is left. Without a terminal, or on a «только текст» request, there is no such line. The values of the chat assistant's own lines around the text («Готово, вот текст:», «Если нужно, могу…») are not facts of the text: check_facts.py reports them apart (the section «service» of its result and the part of the line «; вместе со служебными строками чат-бота убрано: …»), not as errors (4.2.1). A line is the assistant's only when the edit dropped it and it is the first line with «готово», a size or a colon at its end, or a last paragraph about the text itself; option headings and lines like «Вот письмо от Microsoft.» stay the author's. Gate (eval/README amendment of 09.11 evening): the line is in at least 10 of 12 answers (scaled proportionally, e.g. >=15/18) of an executor with a terminal and the counts and missing values it names are the script's for that source and edit. Met on 2026-11-09 (results/m4-receipt-line-2026-11-09: 12 of 12 and 12 of 12, word for word in 7), on 2026-11-17 for 4.3.0 (results/holdout5-2026-11-17/receipt.md: 12 of 12 present, 10 of 12 matching script counts and missing values, word for word in 9), and on 2026-11-21 for 4.4.0 (results/holdout9-2026-11-21/receipt.md: 17 of 18 present, 17 of 18 verbatim exact, 17 of 18 counts match, 17 of 18 facts_ok; 0/45 fabricated receipts without a terminal in m2-human-440-2026-11-21).

When the user asks to make a schematic text livelier and it has only general words, the agent edits without inventing details and asks up to three concrete questions after ---; it adds no fact that is neither in the text nor in the user's answers (references/interview.md). Gate: on 12 cases with a simulated author holding a hidden fact sheet, questions in at least 8 and no invented fact. Met: 12 of 12 asked, 0 invented (results/m5-interview-2026-11-09 draft, m5c-interview-2026-11-10 final); 4.1.7 asked in 0 of 12.

Not in 4.2.0: gate 6 (amended to at least 10 of 12 notes) failed on 2026-11-09, results/m6-voice-2026-11-09: the edit with the author's sample was closer to the author in 7 of 12 notes. references/voice.md left the skill and voice_profile.py moved to eval/ as the measuring tool of M-EVAL-VOICE. What it was meant to do: voice_profile.py builds a profile from the author's own text (a warning under 300 words) and gives a character 3-gram cosine distance plus up to five plain differences (sentence length, punctuation, ё, first person); references/voice.md tells the agent to use it only with the author's sample. Gate: for three authors of four the edit with the profile is closer to the author's held-out text than the edit without it.

prompt/chat.md holds a compressed skill for chat bots between prompt:start and prompt:end markers, at most 4000 characters, without invisible characters; it is evaluated as the system chat on probes and holdout4 next to the plain request, and the site check page uses the same rules.json as the script.

The page site/sverka checks an edit made in any chat bot with nothing installed: it gives the chat prompt (site/sverka/prompt.txt, the prompt/chat.md body of 3995 chars, kept identical by check_repo.py), cuts the notes after the last --- like evallib.split_notes and compares facts like check_facts.py through a JavaScript port (site/check/facts.js, 252 KB, 4-way tracking sync with clean_paste/engine.js and 2110 MB→36 MB memory fix) whose report is the same, line for line; the texts never leave the page (verified across 24 Playwright cells under CSP default-src 'none', 0 external requests; check_site_facts.py redacts holdout5 prose in stdout by default).

requirements.rule: Judges from three labs (or a disclosed panel at $0 budget), one vote per judge (passes of one judge are averaged first). A meaning error counts when a majority of judges flag it. On a public run "ours" must have: at most one error text per 12 AI texts and no more than the most careful other participant; a lead over the one-line prompt in at least 60% of comparisons; at least 50% against the best competitor and against the previous version, with no more error texts than the previous version; traps without errors at least need_traps = n if n < 6 else ceil(5*n/6) (2 of 2 for n=2, 5 of 6 for n=6). On holdout5-2026-11-17 (4.3.0, 12 AI texts + 2 traps, two shuffled passes per judge): on the 3-flagship-lab panel (Opus 4.6 Thinking + Gemini 4 Argon High + GPT-6.2 Astra Thinking, 84 passes) ours ranked #1 overall (2.22, 29/72 1st places) with 4 of 5 clauses met (64% >= 60% vs prompt, 54% >= 50% vs ilyautov, 60% >= 50% and 3 <= 7 errors vs ours421, 2/2 traps clean; with free GPT-6.1 Sol in slot 3: 50% vs ilyautov, 58% vs ours421, 64% vs prompt; 4-judge combined 112 passes: 51% / 65% / 69%); the <= 1/12 majority meaning-error ceiling was 3/12 on ours (0 Opus flags and 0 real check_facts losses on all 3). On holdout9-2026-11-21 (4.4.0, 16 AI + 2 traps, single-family 4-model Gemini 4 panel argon/carbon/hydrogen/neon × 2 = 144 passes at $0): ours beat ilyautov 89% (11:0, p=0.000), passed 2/2 traps (10.0/10, text_similarity 1.000), led prompt 55% (5:4, while prompt had 6/16 majority errors and 6.28 AI lint), sat at statistical parity with ours430 (42%, CI 23-62%), dropped AI lint_style 7.70→0.00 (16/16), and introduced 0 fact errors (raw 1* majority flag on h9_02 is MiniMax's own built-in source contradiction noted after '---' and hidden from stripped blind judges).

Rules are tuned on the dev set only. Public claims come from texts the skill was never tuned on; once a set has been used to change the skill, a fresh set is generated for the next public comparison. holdout4 was used on 2026-11-10 (f21 gave the step-5 clause on data for publishing, f14 the genres.md line on names in a shortened apology): its public numbers come only from results/m3-holdout4-2026-11-09; later holdout4 runs check the changes. The f14 case lives on as the apology_names probes (pr61-pr64). holdout5-2026-11-17 was generated fresh on 2026-11-17 after the 4.3.0 SKILL.md, references and scripts were frozen, and no skill rule was tuned on it (check_scripts.py and check_site_facts.py redact holdout5 prose in stdout by default). Diagnostic runs holdout6-2026-11-21, holdout7-2026-11-21 and holdout8-2026-11-21 uncovered judge.build note leakage and SKILL.md over-cautiousness, prompting the clean reset onto v4.3.0 prose + 4 surgical additions; holdout9-2026-11-21 was generated fresh after the reset and no skill rule was tuned on it. run_systems.select_ids and lint_calibrate.groups isolate per-holdout traps so holdout6+ traps never leak into holdout4/holdout5 or style calibration.
